scientific_integrity: All proof inputs and dependencies are attributed, finite enumerations are distinguished from infinite proof, and an independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected simple graphs with at least three vertices and surjective two-edge-colourings are covered; the result does not address proper/equitable or three-or-more-colour spectra. The complete minimum deficiency uses the established matroid-union rank formula; an equivalent full-spectrum theorem in matroid-connectivity terminology may be unindexed.
title: The complete two-colour wild-number spectrum of a connected graph
